trained_on: Normal beats only (unsupervised anomaly detection via reconstruction error)
threshold_method: 95th percentile of reconstruction MSE on held-out normal beats
note: Binary anomaly detector only (normal vs abnormal beat morphology) — does not classify specific arrhythmia types (AFib/PVC/etc). A prior version of this route fabricated specific arrhythmia-type labels from a synthetic signal; this version reports only what the model actually supports.
